summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.51/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.51 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 15, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 8. AAA figures put the statewide average 29¢ lower than a week ago, 53¢ lower than a month ago, and 86¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.15) and the highest in Superior ($3.90).
